facts.fact: 塔拉辛抬头，正对上夜帝国风暴舰的腹面。
facts.anchor: Talasyn’s pace faltered as rain spattered her lashes and she looked up—looked right at the underbelly of a Night Empire stormship.

facts.fact: 她认出那是阿拉里克的「拯救号」，不明白它为何在此。
facts.anchor: What was the Deliverance doing here?

facts.fact: 事先约好双体船到要塞最西端的塔楼接应她们。
facts.anchor: It had been agreed upon that the catamaran would pass by for them at the westernmost spire of the fortress.

facts.fact: 西塔是死路，一队士兵已用弩箭封住出口。
facts.anchor: But it was a dead end. A group of soldiers blocked the opening on the other end of the enclosed, conical structure, their crossbows already aimed at the intruders.

facts.fact: 塔楼另一侧没有飞船，只有不停的风雨。
facts.anchor: There was no airship waiting for them on the other end of the spire. Only ceaseless rain and howling wind.

facts.fact: 达里乌斯准将认出了凯德，说她还活着。
达里乌斯向阿拉里克纠正凯德的真名。
facts.anchor: “Her real name is Khaede, Your Majesty,” Darius hastily corrected.

facts.fact: 阿拉里克一言不发，转身走进暴风雨，留下部下的尸体。
facts.anchor: But he didn’t. He turned around and walked away—walked back out into the raging storm—leaving the bodies of his troops scattered through the spire.
